title: Goh Joo Hin - Virtual Stores 3D
designStyle: A real-time WebGL 3D brand world with perspective cameras, dimensional storefronts, lighting and textured official assets in forest green, champagne gold and warm ivory.
disclaimer: Independent, unofficial design concept. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Goh Joo Hin Pte Ltd.
summary: Explore New Moon, MILI and GOGO in a real 3D scene rendered locally with Three.js, with camera-driven store navigation and an accessible list alternative.
